notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
AI cards have one image each. number is the card number printed at the bottom right and is not the file order.

steps[].rule is the opening sentence of a step ('Do the first that applies:' or 'Do all that apply:'), null on the Special step. items[].label is the letter of an a./b./c. item, null for a bullet; bullets are used where all items apply.
Line breaks inside an item are joined into one sentence.
Deck icons follow the legend: hand with bars = {DECK_JOB}, plug = {DECK_GEAR}, square with circle = {DECK_CARGO}, ship = {DECK_SHIP}, curl = {DECK_BOUNTY}, gem = {DECK_LUXURY}.
Smuggler-0 was first read as {DECK_SHIP} and corrected to {DECK_JOB} by the owner.
